# Heading 1

The first paragraph after a heading uses *First Paragraph*. Restyle every
style in this document in Word, then pass the file as the reference document.

This is *Body Text*, with **bold**, _italic_, ~~struck~~, `inline code`
(*Verbatim Char*), a [hyperlink](https://example.com) and a footnote.[^note]

## Heading 2

- Tight list items use *Compact*
- Second item
  1. Numbered item
  2. Another

### Heading 3

> A block quote uses *Block Text*.

```text
A code block uses Source Code.
    Indentation is kept.
```

#### Heading 4

Term
: A definition-list term uses *Definition Term*; this text uses *Definition*.

###### Heading 6

| Column | Value |
|:-------|------:|
| Table cells use *Compact* | 1 |
| Header row and borders come from the *Table* style | 2 |

Table: A table caption uses *Table Caption*.

[^note]: Footnote text uses *Footnote Text*; its mark uses *Footnote Reference*.
